name: Past Touichirou
source:
Touichirou’s previous incarnation.
[spoiler]He made a contract with the brother of Futaba's past incarnation. When the brother was about to lose his mind due a curse, he asked past Touichirou to kill him so he wouldn't harm his sister. Past Touichirou obliged, but unfortunately his master's other contracted ayakashi believed the act was out of malice.[/spoiler]
